name: Blademaster
theme: Apotheosis of the dual-wield crit-burst. Endless rotation — crits refund cooldowns, chain hits multiply, the Cascade never stops.
designNotes: Capstone effect mirrors §10.1: 'Crits have 30% chance to refund the skill's cooldown. While dual-wielding, chain attacks gain +1 hit.'
Pairs with assassin.json blademaster path — same id, mirrors path-7 capstone Bladestorm + amplifies via this ascendancy.
8-node compact tree, 3 tiers, ~22 total ranks. Tier-3 capstone gates on Endless Rotation.

Engine wiring status (2026-05-05): 3 of 8 nodes wireable today (Honed Apex / Bladework Mastery / Twin Edge — pure stat-sticks). Crit Cascade mechanic + dual-wield offhand check + cooldown-refund-on-crit action are decorative until Phase F.

nodes.name: Honed Apex
nodes.description: +1/2/3/4/5% crit chance (foundation pairing with the Cascade gates).

nodes.name: Bladework Mastery
nodes.description: +1/2/3/4/5% attack speed (foundation tempo for chain rotations).

nodes.name: Cascade Conduit
nodes.description: On crit, +5/10/15/20/25% chance to add an extra Crit Stack (signature accelerator).

nodes.name: Bladework Storm
nodes.description: +5/10/15% damage per Crit Stack on you (max +25/50/75% at 5 stacks — pairs with Cascade Conduit).

nodes.name: Endless Rotation
nodes.description: On crit, +10/20/30% chance to refund 25% of the consumed skill's cooldown (preview of Bladestorm capstone).

nodes.name: Bladestorm
nodes.description: Crits have 30% chance to refund the consumed skill's cooldown. While dual-wielding, chain-hit skills (Blade Dance, Fan of Knives, Chain Strike) gain +1 hit. The §10.1 ascendancy keystone.
